apply_audio_effects_speed: apply a speed change augmentation to a PyTorch audio tensor with a configurable speed range
apply_audio_effects_filter: apply lowpass, highpass, or bandpass filters to a PyTorch audio waveform tensor using julius
apply_audio_effects_compression: apply MP3 or AAC compression to an audio tensor using a straight-through estimator for differentiability
apply_audio_effects_noise: add Gaussian or pink noise to a PyTorch audio waveform tensor for data augmentation
select_audio_effects_weighted: select a weighted random subset of audio effects augmentations from the AudioEffects class
